admission.justification: A cache can render plausible stale counts or starve the first body request unless revision, merge ownership and request ordering are kept as one explicit contract.

applicability: On-demand hydration of selected task-document content.
conditions: Matching revision permits full previews/collections to be restored.
Changed summary facts retain their current ownership.
Both available and unavailable settled outcomes release ancillary entry reads.
exclusions: Treating a stale body as the authority for current counts/state.

evidence: requirements/MIK-R127-v1-a-task-page-has-one-skeleton-per-form.md rules1-9; source/card witnesses in this entry; approved D219 objective-first amendment. No fresh test execution.

statement: Task body revision includes the display-content inputs, and hydration restores full long content without replacing current summary identity, status, step/progress or review aggregates; ancillary reads wait for the selected body-loading state to settle.
